revisions.note:
REPAIR PASS (revision 4). Two things, both append-only (revision 3 is preserved byte-for-byte).

(1) RESTORED the on_device evidence entry that revision 2 recorded for the archived live capture and that revision 3 dropped. Revision 3 was written as a fresh snapshot rather than the deep-copy+append contract this queue enforces (WORK-QUEUE.md section 1: 'the effective record is always the last revision'; tools/beta/workqueue.py set-state deep-copies), so the drop was NOT deliberate and revision 3's note does not claim it was. The capture is still in the tree and its truth did not change (docs/beta-finalization/live/evidence/touch-20261016T193756+0200-cycl001-p0probe-live-run -> FIRST_FAIL_LAYER=1 NAME=driver STATE=blocked, androidboot.mode=charger, sec_ts_init: lpm 1), but the regenerated ledger's own summary had begun saying this task carries NO device evidence - which an auditor would take as 'no device evidence exists'. The entry is restored verbatim via the tool's own append path, so the summary is back to 3 (00a-repo-preflight, 01a-pipeline-trace-tool, 01c-chargermode-bootmode).

(2) Fixed the console channel this briQ's live run depends on. scripts/s10plus-debug-pack/nuxel-live.sh auto-discovery died with rc=2 and zero bytes of output on any Linux host (the macOS glob does not exist, GNU ls exited 2, pipefail propagated it and set -e aborted before the diagnostic). The glob-safe discovery itself was fixed in this tree by bg-00-preflight (briq-00a rev 7, 8c413a47->49a204dd); this revision adds the part my briQ owed: a --dry-detect (and --glob-root) behavioural self-test, and INV-10's device-discovery claim is now a program assertion that RUNS that path (a glob that matches nothing must not abort; a glob that matches must be found) instead of the grepping-for-'/dev/ttyACM' string check that the dead path also passed. The soft pin moved 49a204dd->8d5c9afb with the old->new pair recorded in the register's history and the authorising briQ named; the guard was re-run (PASS=68 FAIL=0 WARN=8 INFO=2, exit 0).

State and verdict are UNCHANGED: implemented / OFFLINE_TESTED. This boot is still charger/LPM mode, so no finger-tap evidence exists and none is claimed; the archived capture above remains a BLOCKED-layer diagnosis, not a pass.
